description_zh: 批量更新出口代理规则属性
name: UpdateEgressProxyRulesAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter supports only ASCII characters.

Note If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端 Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken 只支持 ASCII 字符。

说明 若您未指定，则系统自动使用 API 请求的 RequestId 作为 ClientToken 标识。每次 API 请求的 RequestId 不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run on the request. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run and does not update the rules. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and the service limits are met. If the request fails the dry run, an error message is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the DryRunOperation error code is returned.

false (default): sends a normal request. If the request passes the dry run, the system returns an HTTP 2xx status code and performs the operation
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会更新规则。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误；如果检查通过，则返回错误码 DryRunOperation。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回 HTTP 2xx 状态码并直接执行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the egress rule group
parameters.name: egress_proxy_rule_group_id

fields.help_en:
The action performed on matched traffic when the rule is hit. Valid values:

Allow: Allows the matched traffic to pass through.

Deny: Denies the matched traffic
fields.help_zh:
规则命中后对匹配到的流量执行的动作。取值：

Allow：允许匹配到该规则的流量通过。

Deny：拒绝匹配到该规则的流量
fields.name: action

fields.help_en:
The key of the match condition. The value must match the effective phase (Phase) of the rule and be used with the corresponding category of operator (ConditionOperator). Valid values:

request:SourceIp: The source IP address of the request. Used with IP address operators. Supported in the PreDns and PreRequest phases.

request:DestinationDomain: The destination domain name of the request. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreDns and PreRequest phases.

request:Http:Uri: The URI of the HTTP request. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreRequest phase.

request:Http:Method: The HTTP request method. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreRequest phase.

request:Http:UserAgent: The User-Agent of the HTTP request. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreRequest phase.

request:Http:ContentType: The Content-Type of the HTTP request. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreRequest phase.

request:Http:Header: The HTTP request header. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreRequest phase. When used, append the header name to the key in the format of request:Http:Header/<HeaderName>.

request:Protocol: The request protocol. Used with string operators. Supported in the PreRequest phase
fields.help_zh:
匹配条件的键。取值需与所在规则的生效阶段（Phase）匹配，并搭配对应类别的操作符（ConditionOperator）使用。取值：

request:SourceIp：请求源 IP，搭配 IP 类操作符使用，支持 PreDns、PreRequest 阶段。

request:DestinationDomain：请求目的域名，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreDns、PreRequest 阶段。

request:Http:Uri：HTTP 请求的 URI，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreRequest 阶段。

request:Http:Method：HTTP 请求方法，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreRequest 阶段。

request:Http:UserAgent：HTTP 请求的 User-Agent，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreRequest 阶段。

request:Http:ContentType：HTTP 请求的 Content-Type，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreRequest 阶段。

request:Http:Header：HTTP 请求头，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreRequest 阶段；使用时需在键后追加请求头名称，格式为 request:Http:Header/<HeaderName>。

request:Protocol：请求协议，搭配字符串类操作符使用，支持 PreRequest 阶段

StringPrefixMatchIgnoreCase: Case-insensitive string prefix match.

StringPrefixNotMatch: String prefix mismatch.

StringSuffixMatch: String suffix match.

StringSuffixNotMatch: String suffix mismatch.

StringRegexMatch: Regular expression match.

StringWildcardMatch: Wildcard match.

StringWildcardMatchIgnoreCase: Case-insensitive wildcard match.

StringWildcardNotMatch: Wildcard mismatch.

NotIpAddress: The source IP address does not belong to the specified IP address or CIDR block

fields.help_en: The description of the egress proxy rule. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_)
fields.help_zh:
出口规则的描述信息。
长度为 2~256 个字符，必须是中文和无害字符串中的字符，可包含中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）

fields.help_en: The name of the egress proxy rule. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
fields.help_zh: 出口规则名称。长度为2~128个字符，必须以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
fields.name: egress_proxy_rule_name

fields.help_en: The priority of the egress proxy rule within its phase. Valid values: 1 to 1000. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Rule priorities must be unique within the same phase of a rule group
fields.help_zh: 出口规则在所属阶段内的优先级。取值范围：1~1000，取值越小规则优先级越高。同一规则组的同一阶段内，规则优先级不可重复
